You: You leave me no choice. I can’t just leave something as dangerous as you to just roam free. Who knows who else is going to get hurt because of you.
Melissa: Reasonable choice. It’s the first time I see you do something logical.
Melissa: The quickest way to destroy me is to destroy my head. Most of the important modules are there.
Melissa: …
#Cashier.Eyes.depressed+Cashier.Mouth.happy
You: …
You: Got it.
I took a deep breath. It has to be done.
I have to do this.
You: I’m sorry.
